question: What happens if a student misses the submission deadline for the bachelor thesis?
prompt_text: [NO EXCERPT — agent must retrieve]
gold_answer: If the deadline is missed, the module is counted as 'nicht bestanden' (failed attempt / Fehlversuch). Deadline: 1 December (HS) or 1 June (FS).
gold_chunk_source: Leistungsnachweise: 'Können Sie die Abgabefrist für Ihre Bachelorarbeit nicht einhalten, gilt das Modul als nicht bestanden (Fehlversuch).' Also Wegleitung §5.
notes: Classic BM25 task: deadline + consequence. Key terms: Abgabefrist, Fehlversuch, nicht bestanden

question: Can a CL bachelor student use text generation models in a thesis, and under what conditions?
prompt_text: [NO EXCERPT — agent must retrieve]
gold_answer: Yes, use is allowed if guidelines are followed: undeclared use is plagiarism; direct use must be cited like any source; corrective use (grammar fixes) requires no citation; students take full responsibility for generated content.
gold_chunk_source: guidelines_on_use_of_tgm.pdf: full document. Key section: 'Referencing automatically generated text' and 'Taking responsibility for automatically generated text'.
notes: BM25 should match on: text generation, seminar papers, theses, plagiarism, citation

question: What is considered plagiarism according to the CL department documents?
prompt_text: [NO EXCERPT — agent must retrieve]
gold_answer: Plagiarism is reproducing text without attribution. Five forms: Vollplagiat (full), Teilplagiat (partial), Verdecktes Plagiat (hidden), Selbstplagiat (self-plagiarism), Übersetzungsplagiat (translation). Can take form of quote, variation, or paraphrase.
notes: FAISS preferred: student uses informal word 'plagiarism' not the German legal category names used in doc

question: If two of my exams are scheduled at the same time, what can I do?
prompt_text: [NO EXCERPT — agent must retrieve]
gold_answer: Student can cancel one module outside the normal deadline by submitting a withdrawal request in the student portal under 'My requests and Invoices', with supporting documents (e.g. screenshot of course catalogue with exam dates). If approved, first exam does not count as failed attempt; student may register for repeat exam.
gold_chunk_source: Assessments page: 'Exam clashes' section: 'If the exams of two modules take place at the same time, you can cancel one of the modules outside the deadline...'
notes: FAISS preferred: question is scenario-phrased, not using regulation wording

question: How can a student withdraw from an assessment due to illness, and what is the deadline?
prompt_text: [NO EXCERPT — agent must retrieve]
gold_answer: Student must immediately notify the department; then submit a withdrawal request no later than five working days after the assessment date, via student portal ('My requests and invoices'), with supporting documents (e.g. doctor's certificate). Without approval, module is not cancelled.
gold_chunk_source: Assessments page: 'Withdrawal from assessment' section. Also Wegleitung §3.6.
notes: BM25 should match: Abmeldung, Krankheit, fünf Arbeitstage, Leistungsnachweis

question: Can a student repeat a failed elective module (Wahlmodul)?
prompt_text: [NO EXCERPT — agent must retrieve]
gold_answer: No. Elective modules (Wahlmodule) cannot be repeated. Only Pflichtmodule and Wahlpflichtmodule can be repeated (once). Failing a Wahlmodul has no further consequences.
gold_chunk_source: Assessments page: 'Repeat exams': 'Elective modules cannot be repeated.' Also Wegleitung §3.5 and §3.6.
notes: BM25 should match on: Wahlmodul, wiederholen, Pflichtmodul. Key distinction between module types.

question: A student is currently enrolled in the CL major (120) and wants to switch to the CL minor (60). Will they lose the compulsory modules they have already completed?
prompt_text: [NO EXCERPT — agent must retrieve]
gold_answer: No, they will not lose completed compulsory modules. The Wegleitung states that within the same study program, switching from major to minor (or vice versa) does not cause loss of credits in the introductory module group or other compulsory modules. However, the CL minor cannot be combined with the CL major.
gold_chunk_source: Wegleitung §3.2: 'Sie können innerhalb eines Studienprogramms vom Major in den Minor wechseln (oder umgekehrt), ohne Ihre Leistungen in der einführenden Modulgruppe oder in anderen Pflichtmodulen zu verlieren.' Also ASTO_060 p.1: minor cannot be combined with major 120.
notes: Ambiguous: answer requires combining Wegleitung rule with ASTO constraint. FAISS preferred.
